name: How long does a full kitchen remodel typically take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a full kitchen remodel typically take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most full kitchen remodels take between 6 to 12 weeks once physical construction begins. The overall duration depends on whether your layout changes require structural wall framing, subfloor repairs, or extensive drywall patching. Custom cabinetry lead times, tile sourcing, and trade coordination also shape the schedule. At HH Remodeling, owner Abraham Becerra serves as the on-site lead and single point of contact, keeping carpentry, tile, and painting on track while directly scheduling plumbing and electrical partners to minimize downtime between construction phases.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full kitchen remodel usually takes 6 to 12 weeks of construction, depending on layout changes, framing needs, and material delivery schedules.
